Class WasmMemory

java.lang.Object
de.christianmahnke.iiif.fliiifenleger.wasm.WasmMemory
public final class WasmMemory extends Object
Low-level helpers for reading and writing into WASM linear memory, built on the module memory contract (wasm_alloc/wasm_free — see WasmEngine).

All addresses are plain Java int values (WASM is 32-bit).

Memory ownership contract (defined by the codec crates):

  • Input buffers – allocated here via allocBytes(byte[]) / allocString(String), freed here after the WASM call returns.
  • Output buffers – allocated by WASM (Rust global allocator), ownership transferred to the caller on return. The caller MUST free them with WasmEngine.free(int, int).
  • Out-parameter slots – 4-byte regions allocated here to hold u32 or pointer values written by WASM. Always freed by the caller after reading.

    • readU32

      public int readU32(int address)
      Read a 32-bit little-endian unsigned integer from WASM memory.

      Used to dereference *mut u32 out-parameter slots after a WASM call has written a length or size into them.

      Parameters:
      address - WASM linear memory byte address of the 4-byte slot.
      Returns:
      The integer value (may be negative due to Java sign extension; use value & 0xFFFFFFFFL for unsigned arithmetic).

    • readPtr

      public int readPtr(int address)
      Read a 32-bit pointer value from WASM memory.

      Used to dereference *mut *mut u8 out-parameter slots after a WASM call has written an error-string pointer into them.

      Parameters:
      address - WASM linear memory byte address of the 4-byte pointer slot.
      Returns:
      The pointer value as a Java int.

      public void writeU32(int address, int value)
      Write a 32-bit little-endian integer into WASM memory.

      value - Value to write.

    • allocBytes

      public int allocBytes(byte[] data)
      Copy a Java byte[] into WASM linear memory via the module's wasm_alloc export, returning the WASM address.

      The caller is responsible for freeing the buffer with WasmEngine.free(int, int) when done.

      Parameters:
      data - Bytes to copy.
      Returns:
      WASM address of the allocated buffer.

    • allocString

      public int allocString(String s)
      Encode s as UTF-8, copy into WASM linear memory, and return the WASM address.

      The caller is responsible for freeing the buffer with WasmEngine.free(int, int) when done, using the byte length of the UTF-8 encoding (NOT the Java String length).

      Parameters:
      s - String to encode and copy.
      Returns:
      WASM address of the allocated buffer.

    • allocU32Slot

      public int allocU32Slot()
      Allocate a zeroed 4-byte slot for a u32 out-parameter.

      Pass the returned address as a *mut u32 argument to a WASM function; read the result back with readU32(int); then free with engine.free(slot, 4).

      Returns:
      WASM address of the 4-byte slot.

    • allocPtrSlot

      public int allocPtrSlot()
      Allocate a zeroed 4-byte slot for a *mut u8 pointer out-parameter.

      In wasm32, a pointer is 4 bytes — identical to a u32 slot. Pass the returned address as a *mut *mut u8 argument to a WASM function; read the result back with readPtr(int); then free with engine.free(slot, 4).

      Returns:
      WASM address of the 4-byte pointer slot.
